items.title: Trump Signs Order Exempting Russia From Sanctions Law - The New York Times
items.summary: President Trump signed an executive order Friday evening to waive sanctions against Russia that had been set to take effect under a new law. The decision has drawn sharp criticism from both GOP and Democratic lawmakers, with Senator Thom Tillis calling it 'beyond irresponsible.' Ukrainian President Zelensky condemned the move as a 'reward' for Putin that will embolden Russia and intensify the war, particularly as Moscow continues attacking Ukrainian energy infrastructure.

items.title: California residents are waking up to their homes sliding into the ocean. And the worst is yet to come. - NBC News
items.summary: California residents are experiencing accelerating coastal erosion with homes sliding into the ocean, and experts warn the worst is yet to come as winter storms approach. The crisis threatens multiple communities including Newport Beach and Balboa Island, with local governments racing to bolster flood protection and slow erosion before conditions deteriorate further.

items.title: Pope Leo returns to the Vatican 4 days after lung cancer surgery
items.summary: Pope Leo was discharged from the Vatican hospital just four days after undergoing lung cancer surgery, ahead of the initially estimated week-long recovery period. Medical experts noted that earlier discharge was possible depending on the patient's recovery trajectory, and the Pope's audiences were canceled through Tuesday.

items.title: Final Trump arch plans submitted to city omit proposed military complex
items.summary: Final site plans for President Trump's proposed 250-foot-tall triumphal arch in Washington, D.C., submitted to the National Capital Planning Commission omit previously announced military features. The documentation shows a scaled-back version of the president's original announcement regarding the monument.

items.title: Standing with farmers: Why US fertilizer independence matters
items.summary: U.S. fertilizer independence has emerged as a critical issue for American farmers, as demand shocks in Asia or supply disruptions in the Middle East directly affect domestic agricultural production and costs. The story underscores the strategic vulnerability of relying on global fertilizer markets.

stlouis.title: St. Louis Wants To Build a $3 Billion Tech Hub—but the Data Center Anchoring It Is Sparking Backlash - Realtor.com
stlouis.summary: St. Louis is planning to build a $3 billion tech hub anchored by a major data center, but the project is sparking significant community backlash. The proposal aims to transform the region into a tech innovation center, though concerns about the environmental and social impacts of the data center facility are fueling local opposition.

stlouis.title: Man admits to scheme to steal 14 St. Louis-area properties through fraudulent deeds - FOX 2
stlouis.summary: A man has admitted to a scheme to steal 14 properties in the St. Louis area through fraudulent deeds, according to FOX 2. The case highlights ongoing property fraud concerns affecting homeowners in the region.

stlouis.title: SLPS cancels Miller–Sumner football season amid misconduct investigation - St. Louis American
stlouis.summary: St. Louis Public Schools canceled the Miller–Sumner high school football season following a misconduct investigation into player behavior. The decision reflects growing scrutiny of school athletics programs and student conduct standards in the district.

items.title: Trump’s pause on Russia sanctions is ‘reward’ for Putin, Zelenskyy says
items.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy has characterized Trump's decision to roll back Russia sanctions as a 'reward' for Putin that will embolden the Russian leader and intensify the ongoing war. The move comes as Russia continues targeting Ukraine's power infrastructure with large-scale attacks designed to make Ukrainian cities unlivable.

The Albanian PM has blamed 'foreign hands' for the disturbances, while demonstrators cite concerns about governance and opportunity.

items.title: Elon Musk agrees to settle lawsuits over 2024 election lottery
items.summary: Elon Musk and his America Pac political action committee agreed to settle two class action lawsuits alleging fraud over his 2024 election lottery scheme, which promised to give away $1 million per day to random signatories of a petition. The settlement resolves legal action brought by residents in multiple states.

items.title: Florida fisher dragged into water and killed by 12ft alligator
items.summary: A 71-year-old Florida man, Steve Hamilton, was killed while fishing at a pond in Winter Garden by a nearly 12-foot-long alligator in a rare fatal animal attack. Authorities subsequently killed the alligator responsible for the incident.

cards.title: Diversify Beyond Tech
cards.insight: Market leadership is shifting away from concentrated tech holdings, with broader equity sectors gaining momentum. Overweighting any single sector leaves portfolios vulnerable to sudden corrections, as recent chip stock declines demonstrate.
cards.takeaway: Review your portfolio's sector allocation this week and ensure you're not overexposed to any one industry or company.

cards.title: Watch Social Security Timelines
cards.insight: Policymakers are sounding alarms about Social Security's approaching depletion date, suggesting legislative action may arrive under pressure. Whether you're near retirement or decades away, understanding how changes might affect your benefits is increasingly important.
cards.takeaway: Visit ssa.gov to verify your earnings record and get a personalized retirement estimate; adjust retirement projections accordingly.

cards.title: Real Estate Risks in Coastal Markets
cards.insight: Accelerating coastal erosion in California is destroying property values and threatening homeowner equity in affected regions. Climate-driven property damage is no longer hypothetical and will reshape insurance and real estate markets.
cards.takeaway: If you own coastal property or are considering such a purchase, commission a professional erosion and flood risk assessment before committing capital.

cards.title: Currency & Geopolitical Exposure
cards.insight: Sanctions waivers and trade policy shifts create volatility in currency and international stock markets. Those with significant overseas assets, retirement accounts with emerging-market funds, or foreign income streams face heightened uncertainty.
cards.takeaway: Audit any holdings or income denominated in foreign currency and consider whether your risk tolerance aligns with current geopolitical volatility.
